days.theme: Kick-Off: The Quantum Era & Hackathon Launch

mainSession.topic: Introduction to Quantum Technologies & Global Cloud Landscape
concepts: The evolution of quantum computing from theoretical physics to cloud utility.
Real-world applications across cryptography, chemistry, optimization, and AI.
Navigating the global quantum ecosystem and open-source tools.

labSession.details: Official walkthrough of project tracks, guidelines, and reference code: Quantum Random Number Generation (QRNG), Quantum Chemistry & Materials Simulation, Quantum Generative AI, and more.

mainSession.topic: Introduction to Quantum Mechanics: Superposition & Measurement
concepts: Classical bits vs. Quantum bits (qubits) and state representation.
The principles of superposition, quantum phase, and measurement collapse.
Introduction to basic single-qubit quantum gates.

labSession.topic: Building Your First Quantum Circuit in Qiskit
labSession.details: Implementing a Quantum Coin Flipper using the Hadamard (H) gate, visualizing statevectors, and simulating measurement shots using AerSimulator.

mainSession.topic: From Curiosity to Contribution: Navigating a Quantum Career
concepts: Interdisciplinary pathways into quantum computing (STEM, software, and research).
Emerging industry roles, academic fellowships, and open-source contributions.
Practical strategies for transitioning from beginner to active contributor.

labSession.topic: Molecular Energy Simulation using Qiskit Nature
labSession.details: Formulating molecular Hamiltonians on quantum computers, using the Variational Quantum Eigensolver (VQE) to compute ground state energy, and plotting H₂ dissociation curves.

days.theme: A Decade in the Cloud & Quantum Generative AI

mainSession.topic: Qiskit 101 & A Decade on the Cloud / QCAT Spotlight
concepts: Celebrating 10 years of cloud-accessible quantum hardware.
Modern Qiskit runtime architectures and primitives (Sampler & Estimator).
Spotlight on regional research initiatives in Quantum Computing & Assistive Technologies (QCAT).

labSession.details: Implementing a 2-Qubit Parameterized Quantum Circuit (PQC) as an implicit generative sampler and training variational rotation parameters (θ) with classical optimizers.

concepts: Finalist team rapid-fire project demos, technical code walkthroughs, and jury Q&A.
Research showcase highlighting undergraduate and graduate quantum research projects (16:15 – 16:30).

labSession.details: Championship Quiz competition, winner announcements, presentation of participation certificates, and official closing remarks.

tracks.description: Building and executing quantum circuits, statevectors, and transpilation.

tracks.name: Decade of Quantum Applications

tracks.description: Collaborative problem-solving challenge with mentorship, pitch sprints, and recognition.
